queries.description: PARTITION BY single key: hash exchange on the partition key, collation prepends it before ORDER BY
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT * FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY col1 ORDER BY ts MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts, LAST(UP.ts) AS end_ts ONE ROW PER MATCH AFTER MATCH SKIP PAST LAST ROW PATTERN (DOWN+ UP+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3), UP AS UP.col3 > PREV(UP.col3)) AS mr
output: LogicalMatch(partition=[[0]], order=[[7]], outputFields=[[col1, start_ts, end_ts]], allRows=[false], after=[FLAG(SKIP PAST LAST ROW)], pattern=[(PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'DOWN', 1, -1, false), PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'UP', 1, -1, false))], isStrictStarts=[false], isStrictEnds=[false], subsets=[[]], patternDefinitions=[[<(PREV(DOWN.$2, 0), PREV(DOWN.$2, 1)), >(PREV(UP.$2, 0), PREV(UP.$2, 1))]], inputFields=[[col1, col2, col3, col4, col5, col6, col7, ts, ts_timestamp]])

queries.description: PARTITION BY multiple keys: every partition key is prepended, ORDER BY keys keep their direction
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT * FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY col1, col2 ORDER BY ts DESC, col3 MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts PATTERN (DOWN+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3)) AS mr
output: LogicalMatch(partition=[[0, 1]], order=[[7 DESC, 2]], outputFields=[[col1, col2, start_ts]], allRows=[false], after=[FLAG(SKIP PAST LAST ROW)], pattern=[PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'DOWN', 1, -1, false)], isStrictStarts=[false], isStrictEnds=[false], subsets=[[]], patternDefinitions=[[<(PREV(DOWN.$2, 0), PREV(DOWN.$2, 1))]], inputFields=[[col1, col2, col3, col4, col5, col6, col7, ts, ts_timestamp]])

queries.description: ORDER BY key that is also a partition key is not repeated in the exchange collation
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT * FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY col1 ORDER BY col1 DESC, ts MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts PATTERN (DOWN+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3)) AS mr
output: LogicalMatch(partition=[[0]], order=[[0 DESC, 7]], outputFields=[[col1, start_ts]], allRows=[false], after=[FLAG(SKIP PAST LAST ROW)], pattern=[PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'DOWN', 1, -1, false)], isStrictStarts=[false], isStrictEnds=[false], subsets=[[]], patternDefinitions=[[<(PREV(DOWN.$2, 0), PREV(DOWN.$2, 1))]], inputFields=[[col1, col2, col3, col4, col5, col6, col7, ts, ts_timestamp]])

queries.description: filter above MATCH_RECOGNIZE stays above it, the exchange stays directly below it
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT start_ts FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (PARTITION BY col1 ORDER BY ts MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts PATTERN (DOWN+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3)) AS mr WHERE start_ts > 0
output: LogicalMatch(partition=[[0]], order=[[7]], outputFields=[[col1, start_ts]], allRows=[false], after=[FLAG(SKIP PAST LAST ROW)], pattern=[PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'DOWN', 1, -1, false)], isStrictStarts=[false], isStrictEnds=[false], subsets=[[]], patternDefinitions=[[<(PREV(DOWN.$2, 0), PREV(DOWN.$2, 1))]], inputFields=[[col1, col2, col3, col4, col5, col6, col7, ts, ts_timestamp]])

queries.description: no PARTITION BY is rejected by default because it funnels the whole table onto one worker
queries.sql: EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT * FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (ORDER BY ts MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts PATTERN (DOWN+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3)) AS mr
queries.expectedException: MATCH_RECOGNIZE without a PARTITION BY clause is not allowed

queries.description: allowMatchRecognizeWithoutPartitionBy opts into the single-worker plan
queries.sql: SET allowMatchRecognizeWithoutPartitionBy='true'; EXPLAIN PLAN FOR SELECT * FROM a MATCH_RECOGNIZE (ORDER BY ts MEASURES FIRST(DOWN.ts) AS start_ts PATTERN (DOWN+) DEFINE DOWN AS DOWN.col3 < PREV(DOWN.col3)) AS mr
output: LogicalMatch(partition=[[]], order=[[7]], outputFields=[[start_ts]], allRows=[false], after=[FLAG(SKIP PAST LAST ROW)], pattern=[PATTERN_QUANTIFIER(_UTF-8'DOWN', 1, -1, false)], isStrictStarts=[false], isStrictEnds=[false], subsets=[[]], patternDefinitions=[[<(PREV(DOWN.$2, 0), PREV(DOWN.$2, 1))]], inputFields=[[col1, col2, col3, col4, col5, col6, col7, ts, ts_timestamp]])
